newsitem.title: MOROCCO: U.N., Morocco set up $1.0 mln information centre.
newsitem.headline: U.N., Morocco set up $1.0 mln information centre.

text.p: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) has set up an information centre in Morocco's financial city of Casablanca to smooth trade with foreign firms, a trade ministry official said on Tuesday.
Dubbed the Trade Point, the centre which is connected to a computer server in Geneva, is located at the Casablanca-based Promotion of Exports Centre (CMPE).
"It will provide electronic data, information on trade transactions in the world and opportunities for business with foreign firms," the official told a news briefing.
The cost of the electronic installation and video equipments was estimated at nearly $1.0 million, officials said.
The centre also aimed at helping Morocco's liberalisation programme which is dismantling trade barriers and encouraging the private sector, the ministry official said.
